summary.text: Jeff Hilovsky was elected in 2022 to represent the 4th District (Oak Orchard, Long Neck and Angola) in the Delaware House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Hilovsky practiced for nearly 40 years as a Doctor of Optometry and co-founded Sussex Eye Center in 1993, retiring in 2022.
Hilovsky is a retired U.S. Air Force colonel who served 25 years, including as Medical Commander for the 512th Air Wing at Dover Air Force Base during Operation Iraqi Freedom.
Hilovsky holds a bachelor's degree from Grove City College and a doctorate from the Illinois College of Optometry.
